line: A Saturday walk sparks something. Leave the earphones out for once.
Someone takes care of you today. Let them pick the brunch spot.
The weekend list runs long today. Cut it in half; keep the fun bits.
Someone appreciates you out loud today. Don't wave it away; say thanks.
A good deal turns up today. Check you really need it, then pounce.
Meal-prep Saturday pays off. Cook once, eat well till Tuesday.
Play mode is on today. Try the new café, not the usual one.
Your eye for detail helps today. Tell a friend which outfit wins.
Your crew is up for anything today. Say yes to the beach or the hike.
Someone books your favourite spot today. Find a new one; it might be better.
